items.title: To the Author of a Sonnet
items.summary: Thy verse is "sad" enough, no doubt: A devilish deal more sad than witty! Why we should weep I can't find out, Unless for thee we weep in pity. Yet there is one I pity more; And much, alas! I think he needs it: For he, I'm sure, will suffer sore, Who, to his own misfortune, reads it.
items.excerpt:
Thy verse is "sad" enough, no doubt:
A devilish deal more sad than witty!
Why we should weep I can't find out,
Unless for _thee_ we weep in pity.
Yet there is one I pity more;
And much, alas! I think he needs it:
For he, I'm sure, will suffer sore,
Who, to his own misfortune, reads it.
Thy rhymes, without the aid of magic,
May _once_ be read--but never after:
items.author: George Gordon, Lord Byron

items.title: D3D: Decoupled Diffusion Drafting for Asynchronous Speculative Decoding
items.summary: La ricerca introduce D3D, un diffusore di token indipendente che elimina la dipendenza tra le fasi di drafting e verifica. Questo permette di generare blocchi successivi durante la verifica in un'unica passata, abilitando il decoding speculativo asincrono. La tecnica include denoising a livello di blocco e supervisione autoregressiva per migliorare l'accettazione dei prefissi.
items.excerpt: Target-conditioned diffusion drafters predict candidate tokens in parallel, yet each new block must wait for updated target-model hidden states. This forces drafting and verification to run sequentially, limiting speedup even though each block is generated in one pass.

quiz.q: Qual è il vantaggio principale introdotto da D3D?
